offering_description.value: Makes and sells fresh, refrigerated natural dog and cat food. Products are cooked in its own US kitchens and sold to pet owners through grocery, pet specialty and mass retailers, where it places company-owned refrigerators.

primary_products.value: refrigerated dog food; refrigerated cat food; fresh dog treats

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery, mass, club and pet specialty retailers that stock the products; B2C: pet owners buying fresh food for dogs and cats

end_markets.value: pet food; pet specialty retail; grocery retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: fresh pet food sold to retailers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: cooks pet food from purchased meats, vegetables and ingredients in its own kitchens, sold to retailers; brand owner: owns and markets the fresh pet food brand to consumers

geography_served.value: global: US and Canada mainly, plus the UK and some European countries

specialization.value: niche specialist: fresh refrigerated dog and cat food and treats

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: grocery, mass, club and pet specialty stores with company-placed fridges; distributors / dealers: third-party distributors supplying some retailers; online: online retailers and e-commerce partners

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: pet food safety and labeling under FDA, AAFCO and state rules, food-plant safety requirements
